name: Art Corb
text: Art Corb is a legendary forefather of the people called the Déisi. The old rolls name him as one of the makers of that band. He stands far back in the account of the building of the southern land. The book keeps little of the man beyond the bare line of his name.

attributes.attribute: legendary ancestor of the people of the Déisi
